retainedFollowUps.title: Implement script toggle (繁體/簡體 content switching)
retainedFollowUps.startCondition: Product owner activates script toggle feature
retainedFollowUps.stopCondition: Toggle switches all learner-facing Chinese content between Traditional (zh-Hant) and Simplified (zh-Hans) characters, including: examples.traditional/examples.simplified, coreSentence, chunks[].chunk, kanjiBridgeNotes[].kanji, reviewPrompts.promptJa, answerJa, distractorsJa, and any Chinese text rendered on the home page, GoalPathSlot, lesson page, and practice questions/choices/feedback. Displayed text, lang attribute, question generation, correct answers, distractors, rendered practice choices, renderer output, and persisted preference stay in sync. The implementing issue must define the paired data representation for all fields that do not yet carry both Traditional and Simplified values; this contract does not prescribe the final schema API.
retainedFollowUps.benefit: Single-script learners can read content in their preferred script without separate routes.

retainedFollowUps.title: Integrate HSK path into production journey
retainedFollowUps.stopCondition: HSK path appears alongside Taiwan Travel path in GoalPathSlot; HSK lesson pages use same BaseLayout + Header with themeEnabled
retainedFollowUps.benefit: Second learning path visible to learners; validates the route sidebar pattern for multiple paths
